description.p: Deep down in the City of Quisuiliae a very special tiefling was born. In the heart of innovation and mystery stands Artyom, an ingenious artificer whose mind is as sharp as the weapons he forges. A master of Riftech, Artyom blends arcane knowledge with mechanical precision, crafting devices that defy the boundaries of science and magic. Among his many creations, one stands above all others - his most prized possession, his greatest companion: Wisp. This collection features items updated to the 2024 rules.
